envelope.description: Make the sized bugfix route keep the ISSUE as its anchor

body.title: Make the sized bugfix route keep the ISSUE as its anchor
body.summary: In src/workflow/bugfix/next-after-issue.ts, the sized branch adds params.epicHash = issue.meta.issueHash and params.storyId = 's1' beside standalone:true and sizeClass:'bugfix', and throws 'nextAfterIssue: invalid-issue-hash' when the sized ISSUE has no 16-hex meta.issueHash. The small branch is untouched. Update the issue() fixture and any advance fixture in src/workflow/__tests__/bugfix-orchestration.test.ts to carry an issueHash, and add the sized-route and refusal tests.
acceptanceChecks: the sized nextCall carries epicHash equal to the ISSUE's issueHash and storyId 's1', with standalone and sizeClass unchanged
a sized ISSUE without a valid issueHash throws invalid-issue-hash and no nextCall is produced
the small nextCall is identical to before
the existing bugfix-orchestration tests pass with fixtures that carry an issueHash

tests.name: bugfix-orchestration.test.ts: nextAfterIssue sized route carries epicHash=issueHash and storyId s1
bugfix-orchestration.test.ts: nextAfterIssue refuses a sized ISSUE with no issueHash
bugfix-orchestration.test.ts: sized-route fixtures carry an issueHash
bugfix-orchestration.test.ts: nextAfterIssue small route is unchanged
